name: The Shanghai EDITION
positioning: Two-tower EDITION hotel in Puxi, a 5 minute walk from The Bund, with a Japanese restaurant on the 27th floor and rooftop bars
best_for: Travelers who want to stay within walking distance of The Bund
Guests who like a mix of bars, lounges and a rooftop garden in one hotel

facts.text: The hotel is at the northeast corner of Nanjing Road East and Henan Road in Puxi, west of the Huangpu River.
The hotel is a 5 minute walk from The Bund.
The hotel is made up of two separate towers.
Suites have an open plan living and dining area, walk-in wardrobes and large angled windows.
Some rooms and suites have oversized furnished terraces.
The hotel has a Penthouse that takes up the entire 25th floor.
Shanghai Tavern offers all-day dining with a seasonal, contemporary European brasserie menu.
Shanghai Tavern's interior references layers of history behind the Shanghai Power Company Building.
Roof is an open-air lounge on the 29th floor, surrounded by an ivy-covered trellis.
Club Room is on the 5th floor and is styled as an early 20th century private social club with a 9-seat bar and a screening room.
The spa has six treatment rooms and a spacious relaxation zone.
The gym is on level 7 and is open 24 hours, with a large outdoor terrace for tai chi, yoga or cardio.

highlights.text: YONE takes rice as its inspiration, serving premium rice from regions across Japan and locally in a modern interpretation of Japanese cuisine.
YONE Restaurant & Bar is on the 27th floor and has signature triangular windows with views of the Bund and the city skyline.
Lobby Bar features bespoke plaster relief artwork inspired by carvings seen on Shikumen (stone-gated) housing.
The private pool area overlooks Nanjing Road and is enclosed in a conservatory designed to bathe the area in natural light.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the modern minimalist style may feel stark for traditional luxury preferences.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
